subject: general
question: Which is a nutritional disorder caused by vitamin B3 deficiency, leading to clinical manifestations from the skin gastrointestinal tract and nervous system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pellagra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pellagra is a nutritional disorder caused by **vitamin B3** (niacin) deficiency.
 
• Clinical manifestations of **pellagra** include skin rashes, diarrhea, dementia, and eventually death if left untreated.
 
• Vitamin B3 is important for energy production, metabolism, and **DNA repair**.
 
• Pellagra was once a common disease in the **United States**, particularly in the southern states, but it became rare after the fortification of grain products with niacin.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anaemia:**

 
 
• Anemia is a **blood condition** where the blood's capacity to carry oxygen is diminished because there are fewer red blood cells in the blood than usual.
 
• It can be caused by various factors such as** iron deficiency**, vitamin B12 deficiency, or chronic disease.
 
 
 
• **Beri Beri:**
 
 
• It is a disease caused by **thiamine **(vitamin B1) deficiency.
 
• It can lead to symptoms such as **fatigue**,** muscle weakness, and nerve damage.**
 
 
 
• **Scurvy:**
 
 
• It is a disease caused by **vitamin C** deficiency.
 
• It can lead to symptoms such as **bleeding gums**, **skin rash, and joint pain.**
